story: Built around that famous opening chord and the jangly rhythm bed underneath it. A real 12-string (George's Rickenbacker) is out of scope for v1, so we fake the character with brighter EQ and a touch more compression than the AC30 tones around it, plus a wetter plate reverb for studio sheen. Listen for the chime holding together evenly across a strummed chord rather than any one string poking out.
